question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., "Neccessary."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is "Neccessary". Its correct spelling is 'Necessary.'
 
• 'Necessary' means 'needed in order to achieve a particular result.' (एक विशेष परिणाम प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Give the **necessary** information but keep it simple.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Neccessary' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
